limits.x-semantic: each value <= the policy edition's value (may only tighten)

ref.x-semantic: sha256 = SHA-256 of the target's canonical bytes (opaque bytes for ct.evidence-content); kind must be one of the field's x-target

record_classes.authored: id, revision (1..4), predecessor (same kind, revision-1, same id), provenance attestation with x-allowed-roles
record_classes.computed: produced only by the application; identity = digest; caller copies are comparison artifacts
record_classes.derived-canonical: ct.claim.v1: no id/provenance; identity = digest; must equal a required claim

ct.claim.v1.x-semantic: claim core: no provenance and no time scope; identity = digest; valid only if canonically equal to a required claim core derived by the application from the request. The assessment time scope is computed per request (CONTRACT §4.2) and carried in applicability rows.

members.x-semantic: sorted by (kind, sha256); unique; SHA-256 of decoded data equals sha256; every required reference resolves transitively; no unreferenced member

covers.x-semantic: applies only to the part of the assessment time scope it covers: full cover applies; partial cover leaves the item pending (reviews) or the declaration not applicable; disjoint is not applicable
